_about: Philostratus in English: Edward Berwick's Life of Apollonius of Tyana (London, 1809), complete in one volume, and J. S. Phillimore's In Honour of Apollonius of Tyana (Oxford, 1912), vol. 1 of 2 (vol. 2 not found), both raw IA OCR. F. C. Conybeare's Loeb (1912) is Greek facing and held back like the other Greek-facing Loebs.

philostratus-berwick-apollonius: The Life of Apollonius of Tyana, translated from the Greek of Philostratus (London, 1809)
philostratus-phillimore-apollonius-v1: Philostratus, In Honour of Apollonius of Tyana, vol. 1 (Oxford, 1912)
